correctness.rationale: The renewal-time formula tau=B+G+1, pgf zP(z)/(2-z), shell masses Pr(B+G>=j), invariant mass E[B]+2 and renewal covariance identity follow correctly by conditioning on binary digits and the transfer equation. However, RESULT.md additionally describes the successive returned positions as "independently uniform" and says "independently uniform returned positions" without restricting independence to excursion labels. Read literally as independence between return coordinates, that assertion is false: take deterministic B=1, independent stationary first-return X0 and X1. Both have uniform marginals on (1/2,1], so Pr(X0>7/8)=Pr(X1>7/8)=1/4. Yet X0>7/8 forces the first geometric digit G=0 and X1=2X0-1, giving Pr(X0>7/8, X1>7/8)=Pr(X0>15/16)=1/8, not 1/16. Thus a stated independence quantifier fails; conditional uniformity given current excursion length remains valid. 57 independent exact-rational shell-density equivalences and this analytic counterexample were checked; a finite test is not a replacement for the analytic counterexample.
residual_risks: Independence of consecutive returned positions is explicitly false under the unqualified written assertion; only independence from the current excursion label is proved.
